pages.title: Bukovina
pages.extract: Bukovina is a historic region of Central Europe that is now divided between Ukraine and Romania.

pages.title: Cumbernauld
pages.description: town in North Lanarkshire, Scotland, UK
pages.extract: Cumbernauld is a town on Clydeside in central Scotland, 13 miles northeast of Glasgow, with a population of 50,500 in 2022. Its centre is a drab vista of 1960s "New Town" concrete plazas and shopping centres, and most visitors are just stopping over on the way to the Highlands. However it's close to attractive countryside along the canal and up in the Campsie Fells.

pages.title: Formentera
pages.description: municipality of Baleares, Spain, containing the island of the same name
pages.extract: Formentera is the smallest and southernmost of Spain's Balearic Islands. The island is flat and sandy with magnificent, unspoilt beaches. There are a few places where the land rises to present spectacular cliffs to the sea. It is perfect for cycling, walking, snorkelling and sailing.

pages.title: Glen Innes
pages.description: town in New South Wales, Australia

pages.title: Mohale's Hoek
pages.extract: Mohale's Hoek is a town in southern Lesotho. It is set among the rolling hills and valleys of southern Lesotho.

pages.title: Mukutmanipur
pages.extract: Mukutmanipur is a small town in the Bankura district of West Bengal in India. It is adjacent to the dam on the Kangsabati River. This is considered as the second biggest earth dams of India. Mukutmanipur is famous as one of the best picnic spots in West Bengal.

pages.title: Navassa Island
pages.extract: Navassa Island is an uninhabited island in the Caribbean that is administered by the Fish and Wildlife Service of the Department of the Interior of the United States of America as a National Wildlife Refuge. The island is also claimed by Haiti. It lies about one-quarter of the way from Haiti to Jamaica.

pages.title: Subic
pages.description: municipality of the Philippines in the province of Zambales
pages.extract: Subic is a municipality in Zambales Province. It shares the eponymous bay with its more famous and bustling neighbor, Olongapo, but has its own share of beach-related and natural attractions.

pages.title: Torbay
pages.extract: Torbay is a seaside suburb on the North Shore of Auckland in New Zealand. It has few attractions of its own, but is close to the beaches of Long Bay and Browns Bay, as well as sporting its own Waiake Beach.

pages.title: Vrbnik
pages.description: municipality and settlement in Primorje-Gorski Kotar County, Croatia
pages.extract: Vrbnik is a picturesque town on high cliff above the sea. It is the home of a good wine, "Vrbnička žlahtina".

pages.title: Raseborg
pages.description: town in the region of Uusimaa in Finland
pages.extract: Raseborg (Finnish: Raasepori) is a municipality of 27,000 people (2021) covering a few towns and a large rural area in western Uusimaa. It is home to a medieval castle and large archipelagos.

pages.title: Romblon
pages.extract:
Romblon is an archipelago province of the Philippines. It is located in the middle of the small Sibuyan Sea which separates Luzon from the Visayas.

The economy is mainly based on farming and fishing, but tourism — especially for diving — is gradually becoming more important.
Nearby islands are Mindoro to the west, Marinduque to the north, Masbate to the east, Panay and Boracay to the south. Mindoro, Marinduque and Romblon are all in the administrative region of Mimaropa, which in turn is part of the Luzon region.

pages.extract: Nanortalik is on Nanortalik Island in southern Greenland.

pages.title: Karangsambung-Karangbolong
pages.extract: Karangsambung-Karangbolong is an ancient national geopark site in Kebumen, Central Java.

pages.title: From St. Augustine to Hampton Roads
Maratha Military Landscapes of India
pages.extract: The Maratha Military Landscapes of India is a  UNESCO World Heritage Site, made up of 12 military forts. Gingee Fort is in Tamil Nadu, and the other 11 are in Maharashtra.
